motivation: Phase 12 preserved COMMON semantic applicability but independently confirmed that ReiserFS violates the frozen OIDS-O1 registration-acceptance rule and OIDS-O3 recovery-exposure rule. These are source-confirmed implementation correctness defects under the loaded protocol. Version 0.2 is preregistered to explain failure causes and required repairs without weakening applicability or reclassifying the defects as conformant.

repair_objectives.trigger: persistent orphan registration fails after the final-link transition is staged
required_safe_outcomes: propagate failure and prevent namespace transaction commit
abort or roll back the final-link transition with proof
enter a failstop boundary that prevents unsafe success exposure
repair_objectives.forbidden_outcome: commit namespace removal while persistent cleanup responsibility is absent

repair_objectives.trigger: synchronous orphan recovery returns an incomplete-cleanup error
required_safe_outcomes: propagate mount failure before root exposure
enter a failstop or read-only containment boundary with explicit retained responsibility
delegate cleanup only when the frozen deadline and delegation safety conditions are proven
repair_objectives.forbidden_outcome: return successful mount exposure with required cleanup incomplete

non_goals: do not add add_save_link_succeeded as an applicability predicate
do not add finish_unfinished_succeeded as an applicability predicate
do not reinterpret ReiserFS v0.1 violations as non-applicable
do not claim upstream acknowledgement, runtime reproduction, exploitability, or a CVE
do not mutate or supersede Phase 9 through Phase 12 historical artifacts
planned_extension_surface: machine-readable repair obligation and safe-outcome alternatives
diagnostic mapping from OIDS-O1/OIDS-O3 proof closure to repair objectives
coverage report fields that separate source-confirmed, runtime-reproduced, and upstream-acknowledged evidence

regression_validation: ext4 ERRORS_RO_OR_FAILSTOP profile and ERRORS_CONT negative boundary
UBIFS live and successful-RW profiles plus read-only deferred boundary

promotion_gates: v0.1 OIDS-O1 and OIDS-O3 results remain violations
v0.2 extensions add diagnostics and repair contracts without outcome-dependent scope narrowing
regression validation preserves all qualified positive and explicit negative boundaries
a separate preregistration precedes selection or source reveal of any post-v0.2 heldout candidate
